components.notes: Finance: one month line by line (ticket sales, what Catch earned, what it cost, what is not Catch's money) beside monthly series, from adminGetFinanceMonth. Costs are entered by hand in a CatchDialog (adminManagePlatformCosts) and the month's ledger CSV downloads for Zoho Books (adminExportMoneyLedger). Backed by the sample in admin/src/features/finance/api/financeMonthRepository.ts.
Lazy live route wrapper owns the Finance controller and the ledger download; deterministic prop-driven visual coverage remains on route_finance.
